# Limei worker

The **worker** calls `run(tasks)` with a limit of `42`.

> Quiet structure remains secondary while [references](https://example.com)
> retain their information identity.

```lua
local active = true
local result = worker:run({ "task:1", "task:2" })
```

- [x] Parse strings
- [ ] Validate numbers and booleans
